# Extensions

Extend Kumbuka with first-party extensions for Markdown, editing, navigation, integrations, and other optional behavior. These pages follow the plugins repository's `main` branch; available releases are listed on each extension's release page.

See [Plugin administration](../administration/plugins.md) for installation and updates, or [Plugin development](../development/plugins/index.md) to build your own extension.

## [Automatic Links](autolinks.md)

Turn plain URLs and email addresses into links.

Note, warning, and other callout blocks
